children: Hong Kong, September 18, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has upgraded Dalian Wanda Commercial Management Group Co., Ltd.' s corporate family rating to Caa2 from Ca. We have also upgraded Wanda Commercial Properties Co. Limited's CFR to Caa3 from C. At the same time, we have revised the outlook to positive from negative on both entities.

title: Moody's Ratings upgrades Dalian Wanda Commercial Management's and Wanda HK's ratings; changes outlook to positive
